nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file that aggregates and re-exports Jotai atoms for session state: agent sessions, view navigation, creator drafts, runtime status, MCP progress, plan approvals, and worktree launch/source caches.

nodes.name: mcpProgressAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atoms tracking MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool call progress per session, with update, per-call clear, and per-session clear actions plus a getter to read progress by session and tool call id.

nodes.name: getMcpProgress
nodes.summary: Looks up the progress entry for a given session and MCP tool call id from the nested progress map.

nodes.name: openCategoryPickerAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Single-atom signal used to trigger opening the category picker UI from anywhere in the session view.

nodes.name: pinnedActionsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom persisting the user's pinned quick actions to localStorage, including a migration step that filters legacy/invalid entries on read.

nodes.name: planApprovalAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages pending plan-approval state per session/tool-call, including atoms and pure helpers to upsert, rehydrate (only when newer), and clear pending plan approvals.

nodes.name: normalizePlanCallId
nodes.summary: Normalizes a plan-approval tool-call id by stripping known prefixes so it can be used as a consistent map key.

nodes.name: upsertPendingPlanApproval
nodes.summary: Inserts or updates a pending plan-approval entry in the per-session map, returning a new map instance for immutable state updates.

nodes.name: rehydratePendingPlanApprovalIfNewer
nodes.summary: Merges a rehydrated plan approval into current state only when it is newer than any existing entry, preventing stale data from overwriting fresher state.

nodes.name: clearPendingPlanApproval
nodes.summary: Removes a specific pending plan approval for a session/tool-call pair, resetting the session entry to an empty state once no approvals remain.

nodes.name: runningLocationAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Simple Jotai atom tracking the currently running execution location (e.g., local vs remote) for the active session.

nodes.name: selectedWorktreePathAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom holding the currently selected worktree path for the session UI.

nodes.name: shellProcessAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks running shell processes per session in a nested map, with atoms to update process state, prune exited processes past a retention window, query process status, and clear a session's processes.

nodes.name: pruneExitedProcesses
nodes.summary: Removes exited shell-process entries from a session map that are older than a retention window, keeping the map bounded.

nodes.name: getProcessStatus
nodes.summary: Looks up the status of a specific shell process by session id and pid from the nested process map.

nodes.name: subagentJobAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages subagent job state per parent session, including atoms to update, prune, and remove jobs, and a helper to check whether a session still has live subagent jobs.

nodes.name: hasLiveSubagentJobs
nodes.summary: Checks whether any subagent jobs for a given parent session are still in a live (non-terminal) state.

nodes.name: tuiModeAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom toggling whether the session runs in TUI (terminal UI) mode.

nodes.name: worktreeLaunchSourceAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom recording the source (e.g., branch, PR, template) used to launch a worktree for a session.

nodes.name: worktreeSourceCacheAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom caching GitHub-sourced worktree data to avoid redundant lookups when creating or launching worktrees.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the settings atoms, actions (update/save/reset/init, external-change and file-deleted handlers), and React hooks used to read and mutate application settings.

nodes.name: installedSkillsAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atoms tracking the set of installed skills and their loading state.

nodes.name: store-organization.md
nodes.summary: Architecture guide explaining the hybrid shared-vs-colocated strategy for the src/store directory, documenting directory structure, state categories (session, project/sync, repo, settings, ui), colocated workstation stores, and import guidelines.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting project sync status atoms, the sync-status event handler, the sync status React bridge hook, and deep-link sync request types.

nodes.name: projectSyncStatusAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks per-project sync status via Jotai atoms and exposes a React hook that subscribes to backend sync-status events and applies them to state.

nodes.name: useSyncStatusBridge
nodes.summary: React hook that subscribes to backend sync-status events on mount, applies incoming events to the sync status atom, and unsubscribes on unmount.

nodes.name: syncDeepLinkAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom holding a pending sync deep-link request to be processed by the app.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Retired stub for the former MainApp tab store; kept as an empty module (`export {}`) now that tab state lives under the workstation tabs store.

nodes.name: addToAgentAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom holding state for the 'add to agent' UI flow, such as the pending item and target selection.

nodes.name: appGridAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atoms for the customizable app grid/dashboard, including default configuration, current config, edit-mode toggle, and a reset action.

nodes.name: backgroundConfigAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Manages persisted UI background/glass appearance settings (opacity, custom colors, glass level) with sanitizing helpers, localStorage hydration, and derived atoms for the resolved background config.

nodes.name: clampOpacity
nodes.summary: Clamps a numeric opacity value to a min/max range, rounding it and falling back to a default when the input is not finite.

nodes.name: sanitizePageOpacity
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a stored page-opacity value by clamping it to the page opacity bounds.

nodes.name: sanitizeSidebarOpacity
nodes.summary: Sanitizes a stored sidebar-opacity value by clamping it to the sidebar opacity bounds.

nodes.name: getStoredBackgroundConfig
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the persisted background configuration from localStorage, sanitizing custom colors and opacity values and falling back to defaults on parse errors.

nodes.name: chatImageAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atom holding image attachments staged for the chat input, capped at a maximum count.

nodes.name: chatPanelAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Large collection of Jotai atoms driving the chat panel UI: width/dragging/visibility state, pagination and display-mode preferences, create-target and start-page navigation, content mode, selected project/workspace/org context, explore panel state, and panel maximize/replay/dropdown controls.

nodes.name: getInitialChatWidth
nodes.summary: Reads and validates the persisted chat panel width from localStorage against a Zod schema, resetting to a valid default and persisting it if validation fails.

nodes.name: resetChatPanelSurfaceState
nodes.summary: Resets all chat panel surface-related atoms (create target, start page, content mode, selections, explore state) back to their default values.

nodes.name: collapseStateAtom.ts
nodes.summary: Jotai atoms managing block/turn collapse state in the chat/session view, including collapse-all commands and per-turn collapse overrides.
